en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from a scholar of our companions, from Abil Sabbāḥ Al-Kināni, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
The clay of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) is a cure even if the clay is collected from the distance of one mile away (from the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.)).
